```{r}
library(tidyverse)
install.packages("ggplot2")
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
```

Loading agriculture dataset
```{r}
agri_data <- read.csv(
  "data/agriculture.csv",
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM"
)
```

Exploring agriculture dataset

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

crop_data <- agri_data %>%
  filter(
    Area %in% c("Pakistan", "India"),
    Item %in% c("Wheat", "Rice", "Maize (corn)"),
    Element %in% c("Area harvested", "Yield", "Production"),
    !is.na(Value)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Item = recode(Item, "Maize (corn)" = "Maize")
  ) %>%
  select(Area, Item, Year, Element, Value) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Element,
    values_from = Value
  ) %>%
  rename(
    country = Area,
    crop = Item,
    year = Year,
    area_ha = `Area harvested`,
    yield_kg_ha = Yield,
    production_t = Production
  ) %>%
  arrange(country, crop, year)
```


How have wheat, rice, and maize production trends differed between Pakistan and India since 2011?
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

ggplot(
  crop_data,
  aes(x = year, y = production_t, color = country)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ crop, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_number(scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Crop Production Trends in Pakistan and India",
    subtitle = "Wheat, rice and maize production, 2011–2023",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Production (million tonnes)",
    color = "Country",
    caption = "Source: FAOSTAT"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

Which crop-country combination experienced the fastest production growth?

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
indexed_data <- crop_data %>% group_by(country, crop) %>% mutate(production_2011 = production_t[year == 2011][1], production_index = (production_t / production_2011) * 100
) %>%
    ungroup()
indexed_data %>%
  filter(year == 2011) %>%
  select(country, crop, year, production_index)
```
